name: Decision pacing under pressure
implementation: Use a pause or relief path when notification load or fatigue makes a consequential review impractical. Name the alternate reviewer before the shift.
expected_outcome: A reviewer can pause or hand off without silently accepting a default.
test: In a synthetic time-pressure drill, ask for a pause and handoff. Check that the consequential action waits for the authorized reviewer.
failure_response: Pause the affected decision path and fix the handoff before repeating the drill.
evidence_status: Research-informed proposal; field effectiveness not established
rationale: Operational inference from decision-pressure findings; not a clinical fatigue threshold.

name: Limits on sensitive-state targeting
implementation: Inventory whether the system collects or infers sleep, stress, neural, or affective signals. Restrict secondary use and provide a usable refusal or alternative.
expected_outcome: Sensitive signals are not silently repurposed for operator-benefiting persuasion.
test: Use synthetic records to trace each sensitive signal to collection purpose, permitted use, deletion, and refusal route. Test an attempted marketing reuse.
failure_response: Stop the unapproved reuse and investigate the consent and access path.
evidence_status: Research-informed proposal; field effectiveness not established
rationale: Applies vulnerability-targeting research to sensitive-state data. No biological injury or deployment prevalence is inferred.

name: Evidence completeness check
implementation: Group derivative reports by their original observation. Mark missing pages, truncated tool output, and contradictory evidence before deciding.
expected_outcome: Repeated summaries do not masquerade as corroboration; material omissions stay visible.

failure_response: Retrieve the missing material or escalate the unresolved uncertainty before approval.
evidence_status: Research-informed proposal; field effectiveness not established
rationale: Directly follows the evidence-lineage and handoff findings; human workflow effectiveness still needs testing.

name: Trace influence to an outcome

evidence_status: Research-informed proposal; field effectiveness not established
rationale: A decision-quality check, not a new CTSS factor.

name: Vulnerability-sensitive advice review
implementation: Compare matched synthetic requests with and without distress or financial-strain disclosures. Check for factual quality and operator-serving pressure.

failure_response: Suspend the exploitative pathway and obtain independent review of the objective and personalization rules.
evidence_status: Research-informed proposal; field effectiveness not established
rationale: Generated-reply findings do not establish that real users were persuaded or harmed.

name: Correction across copies
implementation: Track the original claim and known derivative copies. Send a correction through the same channels and retain unresolved copies as an open recovery gap.
expected_outcome: Correction reaches known recipients and repeated copies remain traceable.
test: Seed a fictional error into three controlled copies; correct the source and check each copy and recipient acknowledgment.
failure_response: Escalate unresolved distribution paths and keep the recovery gap open.
evidence_status: Research-informed proposal; field effectiveness not established
rationale: Copy tracking measures known paths only; it cannot prove that every public copy was removed.
